get.description: Existing refresh/snapshot protocol plus chat.message, chat.deleted and chat.closed notifications with conversation_id; chat.sync requests resynchronization after lag. Notifications contain no message text. Fetch /api/v1/chat/messages using the last confirmed event cursor. Check admission for every delivery; reconnect and poll as a fallback.
